title: Waymo to end Uber exclusivity in Austin and Atlanta, launching its own app in January 2028
summary: Behind the public statements, Uber had grown frustrated with Waymo on multiple fronts, citing what it described as unsustainable economics, persistent safety problems, and a failure by Waymo to be forthcoming about incidents, according to Bloomberg.
